mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months indicates a strengthening economy, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the periods following a sustained increase in HOUST over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a single month signals an improving labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a single month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a single month signals a robust consumer-driven economy, which boosts corporate revenues and stock prices, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases & UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS increased and UNRATE decreased in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% in a single month signals deflationary pressure, which increases real interest rates and reduces consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL decreased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a single month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a single quarter signals a robust economy, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases & UNRATE decreases in 1 quarter
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 increased and UNRATE decreased in the same quarter.
